Sure thing! To submit a vote for the IP address **22.242.75.136** as “malicious” on VirusTotal, you’ll need to make a POST request to the VirusTotal API endpoint for voting. Here’s a quick rundown of what you’ll need: | Item | What you need | |------|---------------| | **API Key** | Your VirusTotal API key (you mentioned “key_four”) | | **Endpoint** | `https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/22.242.75.136/vote` | | **HTTP Method** | `POST` | | **Headers** | `x-apikey: `
`Content-Type: application/json` | | **Body** | `{"type":"vote","attributes":{"verdict":"malicious"}}` | ### Example using `curl` ```bash curl -X POST \ "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/22.242.75.136/vote" \ -H "x-apikey: YOUR_KEY_FOUR_HERE" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"type":"vote","attributes":{"verdict":"malicious"}}' ``` Replace `YOUR_KEY_FOUR_HERE` with the actual value of your “key_four”. ### Example using Python (`requests`) ```python import requests api_key = "YOUR_KEY_FOUR_HERE" url = "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/22.242.75.136/vote" headers = { "x-apikey": api_key, "Content-Type": "application/json" } payload = { "type": "vote", "attributes": { "verdict": "malicious" } } response = requests.post(url, json=payload, headers=headers) print(response.status_code) print(response.json()) ``` ### What to expect - **200 OK** – Vote accepted. - **401 Unauthorized** – Wrong or missing API key. - **403 Forbidden** – You don’t have permission to vote on this IP. - **429 Too Many Requests** – You’ve hit the rate limit. If you run into any issues or need help with the API key, just let me know!
